verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents a public v3 REST Web API with a full reference (POST /v3/mail/send, EU regional base URL), cURL and official SDK quickstarts, and a sandbox mode for validating requests without delivering mail. Event and Inbound Parse webhooks support programmatic workflows, and the docs are served as machine-readable markdown alongside an llms.txt. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the API (community comments only mention it in passing), and explicit evidence that the API covers management operations beyond mail send.
